title: Prime Minister shares an article reflecting on leadership, reforms and transformation
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared an article written by Shri Amitabh Kant reflecting on his experience of working with the Prime Minister, including the importance of dreaming big and the role of reforms in driving transformation. The article also highlights the impact of the Aspirational Districts Programme in improving outcomes in areas such as health, education, agriculture and basic infrastructure. It further outlines how a range of reforms have contributed towards making India easier, simpler and more efficient for citizens and businesses.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
An article by Shri @amitabhk87 in which he reflects on his experience of working with PM @narendramodi, including the Prime Minister's working style, the importance of dreaming big and how reforms are driving transformation.
He also outlines how the Aspirational Districts Programme has helped improve health, education, agriculture and basic infrastructure, along with reforms that have made India easier, simpler and more efficient for citizens and businesses.
